review_note: Reviewed against a live corpus of 306 (plan built at 279). Two detector bugs were found and fixed: slug-token Jaccard over-flags the "vs" and "for" frames, and subject-overlap with a min() denominator let a one-token slug such as what-is-a-grok-bot swallow every slug beginning with "what". Corrected, the genuine same-subject overlap is 10, not the 36 first reported. Those keep a write_rule and a dupecheck gate. 2 inherited entries had corrupted slugs with no search intent and were repaired. A 15-article teaching track was added because the plan was only 25 percent explainer intent.
